overview.title: System overview
overview.intro: Activity of every entity and use of the data disk of the instance.

maintenance.title: Maintenance mode
maintenance.intro: While maintenance mode is on, new deposits are refused on every entity and a maintenance page is shown. Downloads and the administration keep working.

settings.title: System settings
settings.intro: Settings of the whole instance: disk usage alert threshold and alert address.

webhooks.title: Instance webhooks
webhooks.intro: Alerts of the whole instance (disk space, antivirus outage, maintenance mode, master key rotation) sent to a Microsoft Teams or Slack channel, or to any JSON receiver. The alerts of the entities are configured in each entity.

audit.title: Global audit log
audit.intro: Audit events of every entity and of the instance itself (setup, administrator accounts, maintenance, master key rotation).

masterKey.title: Master key
masterKey.intro: Master key used to protect the encryption keys of the files, and its rotation.

banner.text: Maintenance mode is on: new deposits are refused on every entity.
banner.textSince: Maintenance mode has been on since {date}: new deposits are refused on every entity.
